title: The dog ahead
logline: The path between the first trees, and the pup ahead, not waiting, for the first time in eleven years of walks. The glow between the trunks ahead of him. The man's boots at the page's bottom, stopped.

panels.composition: A path between close cedar trunks with a small three-legged dog ahead walking on toward a warm glow between the trees without looking back, a man's boots stopped at the bottom edge of the page.
